_doc: Pre-authorised losses (PLAN §1 clause 4), written by hand from the specs. A conversion report's loss entry is allowed only if a rule below matches (kind, source version, target version, category). 'category' is matched exactly or, when it ends in ':*', as a prefix. Version bounds are inclusive; 'when' adds a condition the checker evaluates (tests/independent/allowed.py). The cell matrix (docs/CONVERSION_MATRIX.md) is generated from these rules.

systems._doc: Satellite systems each version's observation files define (rinex210.txt §3/Table A1: G R S T; rinex211.txt §10.1.3: + E; rinex301.txt p.8: + C; rinex302.txt: + J; rinex303.txt: + I). Transit (T) was removed in 2.11.

--lenient only (PLAN §1 clause 9: data-level damage is refused by default; --lenient repairs what it can and reports each repair): text in columns no field of its record covers has no observation type or meaning (rinex211.txt Table A2: 80-column records, 5 fields of F14.3,I1,I1 per line, event lines without a satellite list; rinex305.txt Table A3 p.59 and rinex_4.02.txt Table A3: one field per declared type, reserved 6X), so it is dropped, one count per line

--align-phases to 3.00 (PLAN §3.3 rule 3): a recorded correction F8.5 has up to 5 decimals (rinex305.txt Table A2 p.57), an observation F14.3 three (rinex300.txt Table A2 p.30): the phase less the correction is rounded half-even to 3 decimals

--align-phases (PLAN §3.3 rule 2): an observation F14.3 holds three decimals (rinex305.txt Table A3 p.59); a phase written with more digits than that, plus a table correction, is rounded half-even to 3 decimals
RINEX 2 has no scale-factor record: values are divided and rounded to F14.3 (rinex305.txt §5.2.11)

record subtypes (e.g. QZSS ION WIDE/JAPN) exist only from 4.02 (rinex_4.02.txt Table 25 p.40, Table A35 note 3*); 4.00/4.01 record lines have no subtype field (rinex_4.00.txt Table A32 p.103), nor has the RINEX 3 IONOSPHERIC CORR record that holds QZSS Klobuchar values from 3.01 ('QZSA = QZS alpha0 - alpha3', rinex305.txt Table A5 l.3634); the record's values are kept
LLI bit 2: anti-spoofing in 2.x (rinex211.txt Table A2), undefined in 3.00 (rinex300.txt ~1970), BOC tracking of an MBOC signal from 3.01 (rinex301.txt ~2227)
Compact RINEX 1.0 cannot hold LLI/SSI on a blank RINEX 2 observation (rnx2crx.c; docs/HATANAKA.md); only with Hatanaka output
a RINEX 2/3 header holds one value per correction type (rinex305.txt Table A5; rinex211.txt Table A3): further values of that type, from RINEX 4 records or merged inputs, have no place

the GPS/QZSS CNAV and CNAV-2 'Integer flags encoded as decimal value (optional; blank if not provided)', a third field of the last record line from 4.02 (rinex_4.02.txt Tables A10 p.81, A11 p.83, A20 p.96, A21 p.98: 4X,3E19.12); 4.00/4.01 define two fields there (rinex_4.01.txt Tables A10 l.4419, A11 l.4545 p.79-81: 4X,2E19.12)

the GEO BROADCAST ORBIT - 3 field 4 is the IODN from 2.11 (rinex211.txt Table A16 l.1976, l.932-935; rinex305.txt Table A16 p.81; rinex_4.02.txt Table A28 p.108) and a spare in 2.10 (rinex210.txt Table A16 l.1671): a spare holds no defined content, so the IODN has no 2.10 field

the QZSS BROADCAST ORBIT - 5 field 4 is the L2 P data flag from 3.03 (rinex303.txt Table A12 p.80; rinex305.txt Table A12 p.77-78; rinex_4.02.txt Table A19 p.93) and a Spare in 3.02 (rinex302.txt Table A12 p.71-72)

a non-zero value in a spare field, or in a field no version defines, that the target's line does not hold: RINEX 2/3 lines have four fields, spares included (rinex211.txt Table A4 BROADCAST ORBIT 7 't_tm, fit interval, spare, spare'; rinex305.txt Tables A6-A18), RINEX 4 lines only the defined ones (rinex_4.02.txt Table A9 p.79 LNAV orbit 7 '4X,2E19.12', A13 p.85 Galileo orbit 5 '4X,3E19.12' and orbit 7 '4X,1E19.12', A23 p.100, A30 p.111). Spare fields hold no defined content and are to be left blank (rinex305.txt section 6.4 p.42, rinex_4.02.txt section 6.4 p.48)

the 4.00/4.01 Klobuchar 'Region code: 0 or blank (wide area parameters), 1 (QZSS only - Japan area coefficients)' (rinex_4.00.txt Table A32 l.5908 p.104, rinex_4.01.txt l.6190 p.108): 4.02 has the area only as the subtype of QZSS CNVX records, 'for the other types the subtype shall be left blank' (rinex_4.02.txt Table 25 p.40, Table A35 note 3* p.117), and RINEX 2/3 headers have no area field (rinex211.txt Table A3; rinex305.txt Table A5 p.65 'QZSA = QZS alpha0 - alpha3'): a QZSS LNAV set's area, or a code another system should not have, goes

STO records name the satellite system G,R,E,C,J,I in 4.00/4.01 (rinex_4.00.txt Table A30 p.102, rinex_4.01.txt l.6062 p.106); S from 4.02 (rinex_4.02.txt Table A33 p.115): an SBAS time offset (SBUT) has no 4.00/4.01 STO record
